+from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, File
+from fastapi.openapi.utils import get_openapi
+from pydantic import BaseModel
+import json
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+class Item(BaseModel):
+    file: bytes
+
+@app.post("/upload")
+async def upload(file: UploadFile = File(...)):
+    return {"filename": file.filename}
+
+@app.post("/item")
+async def create_item(item: Item):
+    return item
+
+def test_openapi_binary_format():
+    openapi_schema = get_openapi(
+        title="Test App",
+        version="0.1.0",
+        routes=app.routes,
+    )
+    
+    # Check for UploadFile in /upload
+    upload_schema_ref = openapi_schema["paths"]["/upload"]["post"]["requestBody"]["content"]["multipart/form-data"]["schema"]
+    ref_name = upload_schema_ref["$ref"].split("/")[-1]
+    upload_file_schema = openapi_schema["components"]["schemas"][ref_name]["properties"]["file"]
+    
+    assert "format" not in upload_file_schema, f"UploadFile should not have 'format': {upload_file_schema}"
+    assert upload_file_schema.get("contentMediaType") == "application/octet-stream"
+    
+    # Check for bytes in Item
+    item_schema = openapi_schema["components"]["schemas"]["Item"]
+    bytes_field_schema = item_schema["properties"]["file"]
+    assert "format" not in bytes_field_schema, f"bytes field should not have 'format': {bytes_field_schema}"
+    assert bytes_field_schema.get("contentMediaType") == "application/octet-stream"
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_openapi_binary_format()
+        print("Test passed!")
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
+        import traceback
+        traceback.print_exc()
+        exit(1)

@@ -476,6 +476,18 @@ def get_fields_from_routes(

+def replace_binary_format(schema: Any) -> None:
+    if isinstance(schema, dict):
+        if schema.get("format") == "binary":
+            schema["contentMediaType"] = "application/octet-stream"
+            del schema["format"]
+        for value in schema.values():
+            replace_binary_format(value)
+    elif isinstance(schema, list):
+        for item in schema:
+            replace_binary_format(item)
+
+
